scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:abrir: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:windows: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
